question: Can a global flood model (GloFAS) set a flood trigger where there is no gauge?

attribution: Fuente: CEDEX, Anuario de Aforos 2021-2022 (Ministerio para la Transicion Ecologica y el Reto Demografico).
Contains modified Copernicus Emergency Management Service information 2026 (GloFAS v4.0) via Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

method.selection: catchment >= 500 km2 and >= 25 years of daily flow in the window
method.annual_maxima: largest daily mean flow per hydrological year (Oct-Sep), years both sources cover
method.fits: GEV and LP3 by L-moments; the better probability-plot correlation used per series
method.cell: GloFAS cell within +-0.1 deg whose mean flow is closest to the gauge's (a best case: it uses the gauge, which an ungauged site does not have); 'model biased' when the best cell's mean flow is outside x0.5-x2
method.trigger: 1-in-5 annual-maximum trigger: return-period (each source's own level) and absolute (gauge level applied to GloFAS)
